module: Tracking of the player vehicle (slot 0) for rally: position, speed and damage detection. At each onUpdate, it rereads map.objects[vehicleId] and triggers a "just took damage" flag when the `damage` value increases by at least a threshold. An optional debug drawing displays position, velocity vector and text. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(damageThreshold)`.
notes: The tracked vehicle is always getPlayerVehicle(0), not a vehicle passed as a parameter.

A code comment says that returning vehicle:getPosition() directly "makes it work" whereas the copy via getPositionXYZ into a shared vec3 is kept: pos() and velocity() return a reused vec3 (same object on every call), it must be copied if kept.
pos() and velocity() log an 'E' error on every call when there is no player vehicle.
The damage is a cumulative value (map.objects[id].damage); only an increase >= damageThreshold since the last retained value raises justHadDamage, and only for the relevant tick.
The wheelOffsets/currentCorners/previousCorners fields are filled in init but no longer updated (updateVehicleCorners is commented out).

C.desc: Vehicle tracker. Fields: damageThreshold (1 by default), vehicleData, lastDamage, lastDamageDiff, justHadDamage, debugDraw, wheelOffsets, currentCorners, previousCorners.

init.desc: Constructor. Gets the player vehicle's data, stores the current damage and computes the wheel offsets in the vehicle's frame.

damageThreshold.desc: Minimum increase of `damage` to count as an impact; default 1.

returns.desc: Id, or nil without a vehicle.

onUpdate.desc: To be called every frame: updates vehicleData and the damage state, then draws the debug if enabled. Without a vehicle, resets vehicleData, lastDamage and justHadDamage.

updateVehicleDamage.desc: Compares the current damage to the last retained one and updates lastDamage, lastDamageDiff and justHadDamage.

pos.desc: Position of the player vehicle (shared vec3, reused between calls).

velocity.desc: Velocity of the player vehicle (shared vec3, reused).

damage.desc: Cumulative damage of the vehicle according to map.objects.

returns.desc: Value of damage (0 if absent), nil if no vehicle data.

didJustHaveDamage.desc: Indicates whether an impact of at least damageThreshold occurred on the last tick.

setDebugDraw.desc: Enables or disables the debug drawing.

drawDebugInfo.desc: If enabled: magenta sphere (radius 1.5) 2 m above the vehicle, cyan line for the velocity (x2, beyond 0.1 m/s) and text "VehicleTracker | Pos | Speed" in km/h and m/s.
